summary.text: Tyson Running Wolf is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives, District 16, who is not seeking re-election to that seat and is instead the Democratic candidate for Montana State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Christopher Paul Buckles, a Republican.

paragraphs.text: Tyson Running Wolf first took office in the Montana House on January 7, 2019, succeeding Susan Webber.
Ballotpedia lists him as winning the House District 16 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House State Administration, House Rules, and Fish, Wildlife and Parks committees.
In the 2023-2024 session, he served as vice chair of the House Education Committee and of the House Rules Committee.
